text:
ops-incbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: unusual embeddings write throughput from ap-southeast-1 detected. 95th percentile token rate x20 baseline. Potential scraper or credentialed abuse. Auto-rate-slice triggered.
oncall-pager: saw it, paging oncall. taking lead.
alice-serve: I can confirm a sustained fanout hitting /v1/embeddings/batch from ~300 distinct IP blocks, many small batch sizes. Keys look valid.
ben-sre: logs show same API key used across multiple geo-proxies, token churn pattern consistent with scraper farm. adding temporary quota cap per-key to 10 req/min.
carla-eng-security: start WAF geo-fencing for SE-Asia regions where majority of traffic originates. also block signatures with identical user-agent + accept-language combos.
oncall-pager: plan: 1) apply per-key quota cap 2) enable soft-block WAF rule (status 429) 3) disable batch endpoint for non-verified clients (use route-based flag) 4) notify customers if impacted. execute?
dasha-product: need to avoid breaking paying customers — what’s expected false positive?
alice-serve: risk low — most traffic is tiny-batch embeddings (<=2 inputs) and high token churn. we'll whitelist keys with recent activity >$threshold and known orgs. create allowlist of top 20 orgs.
ben-sre: executing throttle now: ran command:```
curl -XPOST https://ops-api/internal/quotas/set -d '{"scope":"key","rate":10,"window":"1m"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ops-token'``` throttle applied. starting gradual capacity shedding: 50% soft-reject for new connections, ramp to 90% if not contained.
carla-eng-security: WAF update applied: rule id waf-embeds-geo-2825 -> action: 429, condition: geo in [VN, ID, PH, TH], ua-patterns matched. monitoring.
oncall-pager: deploy-bot, can you flip the routing flag to disable anonymous_batch route?
deploy-bot: started rollout to edge: feature-flag anonymous_batch = false -> 12/100 nodes updated. will finish in 90s.
dasha-product: prepare customer comms template in case any verified customers see increased latency/errors. include mitigation steps and offer temporary quota bump if affected.
alice-serve: cache hit-rate for prefix KV cache jumped down — suspect many short-lived prompts busting cache. enabling prefix dedupe heuristic to reduce repeated identical requests.
ben-sre: metrics after 2 minutes: incoming RPS down 6x, token-rate down 8x. soft-rejects at 52% of new sessions in ap-southeast-1. no major error spikes in dedicated customer routes.
carla-eng-security: WAF telemetry shows majority blocked by UA+geo rule, false positives ~1.2% (one enterprise partner flagged). whitelisting partner key id: k_prod_349.
oncall-pager: good. continue to watch for 15m. if token rate doesn't drop below 2x baseline, escalate to full block + captcha roll.
dasha-product: I'll draft a short banner and email for affected customers, prepped with rollback steps.
ben-sre: creating a post-incident ticket with timeline and remediation runbook: include steps to revert quotas, how to promote whitelist, and how to tune WAF rules.
ops-incbot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigations applied: per-key quota cap 10rpm, soft-capacity-shed 50% -> 90% ramp, WAF geo+UA rule enabled, anonymous_batch route disabled on edge. Monitoring period started. :white_check_mark:
carla-eng-security: thumbs if good to close paging? :thumbsup:
oncall-pager: keeping paged for 30 more minutes, then will handoff to morning oncall if stable. thanks team.
